en: Colorized interior view of a grand historic hall with a sweeping wooden staircase and gallery balcony. The walls and ceiling are richly decorated with large paintings, ship models, carved figures, plaques, clocks, and other ornaments. Two large model ships hang from the ornately painted ceiling. At floor level there are carved wooden doors, framed displays, and upholstered chairs around a table. The image is bordered by a cream margin with printed captions at the bottom and publisher information along the left edge.
